scope: Adversarial verification of the existing MVP 1D script contracts on the locked AArch64 Docker/binfmt runtime; not a final D01-D08 acceptance ledger

observations.D01: Concurrent same-byte inode replacement between secure recheck reads is refused; validation-to-stage same-byte inode swap is BLOCKED. Mutation after secure recheck cannot alter the transferred frozen target bytes; target SHA-256 readback matched the original.
observations.D02: Digest/nonce directory collision left the existing target intact; an injected cleanup refusal retained the issued object and exact retry removed it. Replacing the target inode before cleanup refused deletion and preserved foreign test bytes.
observations.D03: Real target timeout tests reaped child, TERM-resistant and orphaned descendants without killing unrelated target process. Following SIGKILL of the host worker during active execution, independently observed shell PID was absent within a bounded 12-second wait; no report or inferred PASS.
observations.D07: One-shot SIGKILL after allocation, after staging, and during target execution retained only run-owned resources for explicit full-ID/name/label-verified container recovery. Persistent SIGKILL after staging retained the same running container and postinst counter, but left the script artifact; test-owned teardown removed only that observed artifact. Docker network-none, dropped caps, absent host mounts/socket/secret environment, unchanged foreign container state and pre/post Docker container/network ID sets were verified.

limitations: Persistent SIGKILL after stage has no automatic artifact recovery or interrupted report; the object remains until explicit owner-scoped intervention. Do not claim automatic cleanup or PASS.
One-shot SIGKILL recovery was explicit test-owned full-ID container removal; no automatic one-shot crash journal/report exists.

Target same-UID concurrent pathname swap in the gap between stat and unlink was not proved atomically safe; pre-cleanup inode replacement refusal is a narrower result. D02 whole-gate atomic conditional unlink is not claimed.
The shared Docker/binfmt host is not a fresh isolated host or physical Keenetic. Original MVP 1 evidence and A01-A21 release status remain unchanged.
